displayOrder.title: What the complete evidence means
paragraphs: Across the matched views, your current physique remains lean and upper-body muscularity appears maintained. These photos are most useful as an early maintenance and lean-gain baseline, not proof of new tissue gain.

Across the matched front, back, and side views, Back muscle separations are visibly sharper, and the waist area appears tighter with less softness, indicating improved leanness and definition. Shoulder muscles appear fuller and more rounded with clearer separation. Arms show increased fullness and more visible vascularity indicating muscle development. Your September 12, 2026 DEXA measured +5.0 lb of lean-mass change and 8.1% body fat; some of that supports what is visible in the photos and some does not. Keep the visual and measured findings separate; together they do not support a stronger conclusion or explain what caused the change.

The matching poses make broad visual changes easier to judge. Interpret small changes cautiously over this short interval. DEXA on Friday, Oct 9 at 7:00 AM will give us the next body-composition comparison.
